descriptions: Descriptive statistics of holiday-pattern of Dutch population/ trend over longer period for statistical support of policy and planning of government and tourist-industry. Details on holidays / frequency / destination, accommodation / period / possession and use of means of conveyance and accommodation / booking / type of holiday / ( reducing ) costs. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ consumption of durables/ organizational membership.
